user_saw: On Windows machines with an EFS-encrypted cache directory, SQLite snapshot reads failed with 'EXDEV: cross-device link not permitted' and `openclaw doctor` stopped because a state migration refused to continue.
summary: SQLite read-only snapshot preparation copies straight into the partial file instead of renaming an intermediate 'first' file, and final publication falls back to a guarded copy plus fsync when rename fails with EXDEV.
reasoning: Issue #169157 (opened 2026-10-11) shows Windows EFS returning EXDEV for a rename between two files in the same directory, an OS/filesystem quirk outside the code; the rename-based snapshot publication was correct on normal filesystems and predates the 2026-09-03 graft (local history of src/infra/sqlite-readonly-location.ts reaches the graft), so no introducing commit can be named. It could also be read as never-worked for that setup, but with no identifiable cause and an external platform behavior, latent with no trigger fits best.
